response.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS disposition_count
FROM disp
WHERE account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'DISPONENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
);

assumptions.assumption: An account is non-disponent when none of its disposition rows has type 'DISPONENT'; count every disposition row on those accounts, including any 'USER' rows.
